note: Curated, read-only ReloPass how-to corpus for the in-app Setup & Help Assistant. Every step, route and feature name below reflects the shipped product. The assistant must ground answers ONLY in these topics and must not invent features, steps, or routes.

topics.title: Complete your company profile
topics.applies_when: First-run HR workspace, or when policy/case pages say your account isn't linked to a company.
steps: Open Company Profile from the HR menu.
Fill in your company name, country, and full company address (street, city, postal code).
Add HQ city, industry, and company size — these help ReloPass pre-fill sensible policy suggestions.
Save. The profile powers policy defaults and appears on employee-facing case records.
gotchas: A brand-new HR account may not be linked to a company yet — policy and case pages then show a 'Complete your account setup' notice. Linking is done by your ReloPass admin; contact them if that message persists.
The company address is required downstream; leaving it blank can block later steps.

topics.title: Draft and publish a relocation policy
topics.applies_when: You need employees to see benefits/caps, or a case shows no policy configured.
steps: Open the Policy Builder.
If you don't have a signed-off policy file yet, pick a starter baseline — Conservative, Standard, or Premium — as a starting point you can edit.
Alternatively, upload your approved company policy document; ReloPass saves it as a draft until you publish.
Review the benefit table and adjust any numbers or labels.
When the page shows the draft is ready, choose Publish version to make it live.
gotchas: Drafts are visible to HR only. Employees see a policy ONLY after you publish a version.
Every starter number and label is illustrative — change it before or after going live.
Uploading a document does not go live on its own; you still have to publish that version.

topics.title: Create your first relocation case
topics.applies_when: You have no cases yet, or you're onboarding a new relocating employee.
steps: Open the HR Command Center — it lists your case portfolio.
When there are no cases, use the first-run 'Open your first case' surface (you can accept or edit the suggested destination and working location).
A case is the record for one employee's move: it holds their timeline, documents, vendor assignments, and compliance status.
Fill in the basic move details to create the case.
gotchas: The suggested setup panel pre-fills values from what ReloPass already knows; everything stays editable and you can skip the suggestions.

topics.title: Assign and invite an employee to a case
topics.applies_when: A case exists but no employee is attached to it yet.
steps: Open the case from the HR Command Center.
Assign the employee by their email address — this creates the assignment and an invite for them.
The employee registers (or logs in) with that email and then claims the case using the invite.
Once claimed, the case appears in the employee's journey and shows up on your portfolio.
gotchas: Claiming is NOT automatic on registration. The employee must explicitly claim the case with the invite token; simply signing up does not link them.
Make sure you assign to the same email the employee registers with.

topics.title: What the employee does next
topics.applies_when: You've invited an employee and want to guide them, or they ask what to do.
steps: The employee registers a ReloPass account with the email you invited.
They claim their assigned case using the invite you sent.
They complete intake — origin and destination, move date, purpose, and household details.
Intake unlocks their services & policy view and a step-by-step relocation roadmap.
gotchas: Account registration is rate-limited to 5 sign-ups per hour from the same source; if an employee hits this, wait and retry.
If the employee registered but sees no case, they most likely haven't claimed the invite yet.

topics.title: Track cases in the HR Command Center
topics.applies_when: You want a portfolio view of all active relocations and where attention is needed.
steps: Open the HR Command Center for the portfolio dashboard.
Review KPI tiles — Active Cases, Action Required, Departing Soon, At Risk, Overdue Tasks, Budget Overruns.
Filter the Cases table by risk level (green / yellow / red).
Click any case row to open its detail: tasks progress, SLA status, budget, and next deadline.
gotchas: Risk badges are Green (on track), Yellow (attention needed), and Red (at risk) — use them to triage which cases to open first.

topics.title: Monitor policy usage and handle exceptions
topics.applies_when: You've published a policy and want to see utilisation or review out-of-policy requests.
steps: Open the Policy Dashboard to see active-policy status, per-category utilisation, and a compliance table.
Open the exceptions queue to review requests that fall outside policy caps.
Approve or reject each exception; your decision is recorded against the case.
gotchas: The dashboard only reflects a policy once it's published — a draft won't populate utilisation.
The exceptions queue is also surfaced on the Command Center so you don't miss pending approvals.

topics.title: Roadmap and relocation tasks
topics.applies_when: You want to understand the employee's step-by-step plan and task checklist.
steps: Each case has a relocation roadmap — an ordered set of steps for the move, with a document count on each step.
The task checklist tracks the concrete to-dos for the case; progress rolls up as a Tasks Done % on the Command Center.
As the employee completes intake and uploads documents, roadmap steps and tasks update automatically.
gotchas: The roadmap is generated from the case's corridor and intake, so it only fills in after the employee completes intake.
Employees see their own roadmap inside their journey; HR sees roadmap and task progress from the case detail in the Command Center.
